channel.title: Growth Recon Intel
channel.description: Tactical breakdowns from 20 years of building growth systems. No theory. No fluff. Just what works.

item.title: How to Audit Every Step Between Click and Customer
item.description: Your funnel has leaks. Every step between first touch and payment is a potential exit point. Here's how to find and fix every one of them.

item.title: Why Your Best Customers Leave and Your Worst Ones Stay
item.description: High-value customers churn because you're not solving their evolving needs. Low-value customers stay because they have nowhere else to go. Here's how to fix both.

item.title: Where Your Marketing Budget Is Actually Going
item.description: Channel A costs X delivering Y. Channel B costs 10X delivering Y/5. Most companies can't answer why Channel B still exists.

item.title: The Campaign Everyone Loves But Nobody Buys From
item.description: Every company has one. The initiative that gets standing ovations in all-hands but can't show a single pipeline dollar. Here's how to kill it.

item.title: How to Push Change Through a Team That Doesn't Want It
item.description: People don't resist change because they're lazy. They resist because change threatens their status, comfort, and identity. Here's how to navigate it.

item.title: Your Analytics Are Lying to You - Here's What to Fix
item.description: Bad tracking doesn't just mean bad reports. It means bad decisions built on bad data. Here's how to audit what you're actually measuring.

item.title: How to A/B Test Without Fooling Yourself
item.description: Most A/B tests are declared winners too early, measured wrong, or testing the wrong thing entirely. Here's how to actually learn from experiments.

item.title: How to Figure Out Who Actually Buys From You
item.description: Your pitch deck says one thing about your customer. Your revenue data says another. Here's how to map who actually converts.

item.title: Why Your Customers Don't Understand Your Website
item.description: You describe your solution in your words. Your customers describe their problem in theirs. That gap is where your conversion rate goes to die.

item.title: Why Traffic Won't Save a Broken Funnel
item.description: Pouring traffic into a broken funnel doesn't fix it - it just makes the leak bigger. The Convert stage of Growth Recon fixes foundations before spend.

item.title: Your Marketing Budget Has a 40% Leak - Here's How to Find It
item.description: Most marketing budgets carry 30-50% waste nobody wants to talk about. The Expose stage of Growth Recon forces the conversation.

item.title: Why Good Strategy Dies in Implementation
item.description: The hardest part of growth isn't the strategy. It's getting humans to follow it. The Navigate stage of Growth Recon drives adoption through resistance.

item.title: The Operating System Your Marketing Team Doesn't Have
item.description: Most marketing teams run on chaos. The Optimize stage of Growth Recon builds the operating rhythm that turns execution into a system.

item.title: Everything You Think You Know About Your Customer Is Wrong
item.description: Most companies build strategy on assumptions about who buys and why. The Research stage of the Growth Recon framework replaces guesswork with evidence.
